attribution.role: ancestor cache-enabled timing evidence; advisory ranking, not exact current-base timings

unprofiled_base_delta.limitation: PR485 changed catalog/config/protocol tests after profiling. Current D CI must rediscover and execute every unit; affected current weights require artifact review before merge.

attribution.verification: Root API/source/runtime freeze and independent raw audits accepted both paired current-runtime samples, including 38 strict new ordinary run/pass lifecycles each. Artifact attribution is externally verified, not self-attested by raw JSON.

provenance.policy: median seconds then half-up integer ms, minimum 1; package terminal elapsed; CLI max(parent elapsed, active subtree envelope); unknown discovered units 1000ms; auxiliary phases excluded
provenance.usage: advisory ranking only; dynamic discovery and current CI are authoritative
